description: Patient_ID must not be null or blank.
logic: Fail when Patient_ID is null, empty, or whitespace-only.

description: Populated Patient_ID values must be unique after trimming whitespace.
logic: Among non-null Patient_ID values, fail every row whose identifier occurs more than once.

description: Date of Birth must be a parseable date, not in the future, and within a plausible range.
logic: When Date_of_Birth is populated, pass if it parses to a date between 1900-01-01 and the project as-of date (2026-08-20). Blank values are completeness issues, not validity failures.

description: Gender must match the approved value set exactly.
logic: Pass when Gender is one of Female, Male, Unknown.

description: Patient.Facility_ID must exist in the facility master reference dataset.
logic: Fail when Facility_ID is null or does not match facilities_master.Facility_ID.

description: Encounter.Patient_ID must exist in the patient dataset.
logic: Fail when Encounter.Patient_ID is null or not present in patients.Patient_ID.

description: Encounter.Provider_ID must exist in the provider dataset.
logic: Fail when Encounter.Provider_ID is null or not present in providers.Provider_ID.

description: Encounter.Facility_ID must exist in the facility master reference dataset.
logic: Fail when Encounter.Facility_ID is null or does not match facilities_master.Facility_ID.

description: Encounter_Date must be a parseable date and cannot be in the future.
logic: When Encounter_Date is populated, pass if it parses to a date on or before the project as-of date (2026-08-20). Blank values are completeness issues, not validity failures.
